sources.name: periwinkle_plant
sources.author: Amal Kumar
sources.adaptation: Existing frozen original mesh geometry and PBR maps; world transforms baked, root datum normalized, uniformly scaled, instanced on raycast dry terrain. No global asset changes.

construction: Actual original licensed multi-leaf/stem mesh geometry and original PBR surface maps. Each plant retains uniform scale and all original mesh triangles. No whole-plant billboard, scene photograph, scene plate, depth substitute or reference RGB is rendered.
placement: Root positions are raycast against actual dry ground after garden warping. Water, stair/curb reserve, toro foot reserve and actual stone intersections are rejected. Roots are buried 12mm in support.
limits: Specific species and inferred placements are reconstruction hypotheses; CC0 acquisition provenance and original asset hashes remain in frozen global manifests.
